requirement_vague: Verify that a second user cannot read another user's item. Confirm access is denied.

omissions.description: Reading an item by a second user is not access-restricted as required. The GET /api/v1/items/{item_id} endpoint should deny access with status 400 and detail "Not enough permissions" when the requester is not the owner, but it returns the item without any ownership check.
omissions.reasoning: In read_item, the code only checks whether the item exists and then returns it. Unlike update_item and delete_item, there is no guard such as `if not current_user.is_superuser and item.owner_id != current_user.id: raise HTTPException(status_code=400, detail="Not enough permissions")`. Therefore a second user can read another user's item, so access is not denied.
